attempted_claim: Let C_{Δ=0} = {(C,f) cork | Δ_{(C,f)} = 0 in HM^{red}_{-1}(∂C; F_2)} and C̄_{Δ=0} = {(C,f) | (−C,f) ∈ C_{Δ=0)}, with Δ the mod-2 monopole-Floer difference element and sequential relation as in Ladu Def. 2.3. Does there exist a simply-connected closed exotic pair (X_0,X_1) with b^+(X_0) ≥ 2 that is not sequentially related by C_{Δ=0} ∪ C̄_{Δ=0}? Concrete test case: Ladu's infinite family with X_0 a Chen minimal complex surface of general type (σ=1, b^+ ≥ 50, non-spin, simply connected) and X_1 = (−X̃)#CP^2 with X̃ simply-connected symplectic (σ=0, b^+(X_1)=b^+(X_0)), which satisfies |B_{Z/2}(±X_0)| ≠ |B_{Z/2}(±X_1)| on each orientation separately.
decisive_failure: The mixed-orientation union C union Cbar preserves only one orientation's mod-2 basic-class count per step, so Ladu's cardinality argument does not compose; the reachability model shows start (nonzero,zero) reaches end (zero,nonzero) in two mixed steps. A proof would need a new two-sided gauge-theoretic obstruction, unavailable on this pass.
